svg.title: Save beside Approve
svg.text: Save beside Approve
You fill in what's missing and save it; Pieter opens it later and approves. Approve is never automatic.
A. Save button, and fields still save as you leave them
Recommended
Save confirms with a toast; nothing you typed is lost if you close the tab first.

svg.text: Notes
Both: Approve stays grayed out until there's a contractor and a total, with no line under it.
A keeps today's save-as-you-leave, so the Save button only adds the confirmation you asked for.
B is how most forms work, but a tab closed mid-edit loses the typing unless the leave warning catches it.
